title: FusionForge v2 export bundle (<space>/exports/<project>-<YYYYMMDD>.json by default)
description: Opt-in persistence of one project's recipes and lessons, redacted (no absolute paths; evidence sources removed, sha256 kept). Never auto-committed. import accepts only a bundle of the same project, keeps each recipe's status with imported: true; evidence that is not on the importing machine is a warning (EVIDENCE_NOT_LOCAL) and reuse weighs imported recipes x0.8. A recipe imported as tested becomes verified only after a verify-node trace with evidence on the importing machine (GATE_EVIDENCE_NOT_LOCAL otherwise), and promote refuses imported recipes that were not verified there (NOT_PROVEN).
